title: Ironbark on‑prem sprint notes
body:
Purpose:
Quick, messy sprint scratchpad for Ironbark Health on-prem deployment. Meant for day-to-day notes, runbook fragments, and immediate action items. Not polished; will extract into formal runbook once stable.

Customer/context:
- Ironbark Health: regulated healthcare customer, needs on-prem Redwood Private with VPC-equivalent isolation, KMS integration, and audit logs retained 13 months.
- Target infra: 3x A100 nodes (40GB), 1x control plane VM (8vCPU/32GB), NFS for shared artifacts.
- Deadline: initial PoC showback week of 2026-03-22.

High-level objectives for this sprint:
- Get control-plane up with TLS certs and KMS stubbed to test keys.
- Bring up 2 serving nodes with GPU drivers + NCCL checks; run baseline latency test vs hosted.
- Validate model onboarding flow for llm-7b-q4f (quantized) and fallback to llm-7b-fp16.
- Wire audit logs to S3-compatible storage (minio) and confirm retention policy.

Immediate checklist (today):
- [ ] Finalize A100 AMI + nvidia-driver 525+ kernel module version. (Marcus)
- [ ] Create service account in Ironbark AD and confirm network egress rules for control plane. (Tara)
- [ ] Generate temporary test KMS keypair; add to control plane secrets manager. (Riya)
- [ ] Mount NFS on all nodes under /redwood/artifacts and confirm permissions. (Riya)

Notes / commands used:
- Kernel + driver check:
  sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y build-essential dkms
  sudo systemctl stop display-manager || true
  sh NVIDIA-Linux-x86_64-525.run --silent
  nvidia-smi -L  # expect 1-2 GPUs per node

- Verify NCCL / multi-GPU basic:
  export NCCL_DEBUG=INFO
  python -c "import torch; print(torch.cuda.device_count())"

- Quick Redis handshake for cache:
  redis-cli PING

Config fragments to capture later (copy into runbook):
- Control plane env: REDWOOD_MODE=private
  REDWOOD_KMS_PROVIDER=minio-kms
  REDWOOD_AUDIT_SINK=s3://irb-audit-logs
- Serving node flags:
  --model-cache-size=24GB
  --batching-strategy=latency-biased
  --max-batch-tokens=4096

Model onboarding issues found:
- llm-7b-q4f: needs custom kernel with int8 matmul optimizations; fallback to q4f fails when token_length>2048. Need to test seq-len distribution on customer samples.
- Check quantization artifacts path permissions; model loader expects 644 but packaging pipeline writes 600. Quick fix: chmod 644 on tar extraction.

Observability / tracing quick wins:
- Enable token-level latency sampling at 0.1% for PoC to not overwhelm storage.
- Add a per-route dashboard for /generate with 95th, p99 latency, and token-cost. Use tracing id header X-Trace-Id.

Outstanding questions (to resolve with infra/security):
- Can Ironbark provide HSM-backed KMS or do we need a proxy to their HSM? (ask security)
- Network egress: do we need to block all external outbound except S3/minio endpoints?
- Audit retention: confirm 13 months is acceptable — billing/ops implications for storage.

Risks / mitigation:
- Driver mismatch -> roll back to previous AMI snapshot. Keep a golden snapshot before driver install.
- Model failure under quantization -> keep a canary route pegged to fp16 model for critical customer flows. Canary percent start at 5%.

Mini timeline (next 10 days):
- Day 0-2: infra prep, driver + NFS + control plane bootstrap (this sprint).
- Day 3-5: model onboarding + baseline perf tests (llm-7b variants).
- Day 6-8: observability hooks + audit sink validation.
- Day 9-10: internal PoC run + anomalies triage + customer showback prep.

Action items (owners):
- Marcus: build AMI snapshot and validate GPU drivers on two spare dev nodes. Report success/failure by EOD 2026-03-06.
- Tara: submit JIRA for AD service account and network ACL rules (JIRA-IRB-78).
- Riya: prepare minimal runbook excerpt and demo script for showback; collect tokenized sample traces for seq-len analysis.

Quick logs / one-off notes:
- 2026-03-06 09:18: control-plane TLS cert auto-renew failed once — missing SAN for internal hostname. Temporarily added SAN and restarted.
- 2026-03-07 14:44: model load failed with PermissionError on /redwood/artifacts/models/llm-7b-q4f/model.bin (fixed with chmod during test).

Grab-for-runbook (to formalize):
- Exact driver install steps + rollback commands.
- Minimal firewall ruleset for on-prem deployment.
- KMS integration flow diagram (control plane -> KMS -> HSM).
- Canary rollout steps and CLI commands for changing percent and fallback.

Notes to self:
- Keep this doc messy. After showback, move finalized checklist into Confluence page CONFLUENCE-IRB-setup-2026 and link in JIRA.

Next edit planned: 2026-03-13 after the AMI validation results.

---- end scratchpad ----
